What do you think of making this `auto stack = witness.ToVectors()` and changing it to `const auto pop{[&](std::vector<valtype>& stack) {` and `pop(stack)` so that the `stack` variables are scoped to where they're used?
[2026-11-27] rc:4715523604 inline on src/script/script.h by ajtowns (member) (edited 2026-11-27):
The back() commit feels hardest to justify. Arguably:
 * just having back() be O(1) isn't enough -- if annexes become standard, we want to access both the last and second last elements quickly for standardness checks; and conceivably we could want to access the third last element as well if a script size check was re-introduced or similar.
 * back() not being O(1) is a potential footgun for the future, but so is operator[] not being O(1)

Perhaps a `ToLastSpans(n)` that returns a vector of the last (up to) n stack elements would eventually be more useful?
